“我不能去仙界。”时笙摇头，神色惆怅，“我还只是筑基，飞升仙界离我还很远。”

凤辞皱了皱眉。

“不过你可以留在修真界。”时笙眸子亮晶晶的，“你在仙界待了很久吧？换个地方祸……待着，也是一种体验。”

“我留在这里，你就会和我在一起吗？”

“对啊！”本宝宝还要扶持你登上仙帝的宝座，当然得和你在一起。

先刷好感度和信任度！

“好。”

时笙默默的将腹中无数的游说词删掉，都不给一点发挥口才的机会，这答应得也太快了。

前期的反派这么好哄？

凤辞从来没有遇到一个能接近他的人，在看到时笙能接近自己，他当然开心，而且已经打算圈养起来了。

“我去把那条蛇抓来给你当坐骑。”凤辞伸手拉住时笙的手，带着她往雷云最密集的那边去。

嗯，他的人，就应该用最好的东西。

虽然胤蛇没有龙好，不过在凡俗界和修真界也算是最好的，等到了仙界在去给她抓龙。

时笙完全不知道凤辞的打算，只是在听到凤辞要去抓胤蛇的时候，整个人惊呆了。

这个反派对她是不是太好了点？

可是为什么这次不是攻略任务？

系统难道早就知道了？

系统这个渣……

太贱了有木有！

于是刚渡完劫，准备飞升的胤蛇被凤辞抓着，强迫它和时笙定了契约。

胤蛇是拒绝的，可是在绝对的武力面前，它连一个不字都不敢吭。

它好不容易熬到渡劫，以为美好的日子在等着它，谁知道还没渡劫被一个人类抢了升仙草，渡完劫就被契约了。

它得罪谁了啊！

“以后你就叫布丁吧！”时笙摸了摸胤蛇的脑袋，不对，它现在已经是胤龙了。

胤蛇飞升后就是胤龙，只不过比不得其他血统纯正的龙族。

布丁？

这是什么名字，一点都不拉风，不要不要！

凤辞周身的火焰一盛，胤龙身子抖了抖，布丁就布丁吧！

"I can't go to the fairy world." Shi Sheng shook his head, looking melancholy, "I'm just building a foundation, and ascending to the fairy world is still far away from me."

Feng Ci frowned.

"But you can stay in the world of cultivation." Shi Sheng's eyes were bright, "You have been in the fairy world for a long time, right? It's also an experience to stay in a different place..."

"If I stay here, will you stay with me?"

"That's right!" I want to help you ascend to the throne of the Immortal Emperor, and of course I have to be with you.

First, brush up your favorability and trust!

"Okay."

Shi Sheng silently deleted the countless lobbying words in his mind without giving him a chance to use his eloquence. He agreed too quickly.

Are the early villains so easy to coax?

Feng Ci had never met anyone who could get close to him. When he saw that Shi Sheng could get close to him, he was of course happy and was already planning to keep him in captivity.

"I'll catch that snake and use it as a mount for you." Feng Ci reached out and took Shi Sheng's hand, leading her to the side where the thunderclouds were densest.

Well, his people should use the best things.

Although Yin She is not as good as the dragon, she is still considered the best in the mortal world and the world of cultivation. When she gets to the fairy world, she will catch the dragon for her.

Shi Sheng had no idea what Feng Ci was planning, but was shocked when he heard that Feng Ci was going to catch Yin She.

Is this villain too kind to her?

But why isn’t it a strategy mission this time?

Did the system already know this?

The system is scumbag...

It's too cheap, isn't it?

So Yin Snake, who had just finished its catastrophe and was about to ascend, was caught by Feng Ci and forced it to make a contract with Shi Sheng.

Yin She refused, but in the face of absolute force, she didn't even dare to say no.

It finally survived the tribulation, thinking that better days were waiting for it. Unexpectedly, it was robbed of the Immortal Grass by a human before it could survive the tribulation. After the tribulation, it was contracted.

Who did it offend?

"From now on, you can call her Pudding!" Shi Sheng touched Yin Snake's head. No, it is now Yin Long.

After Yin Snake ascends, he becomes Yin Long, but he is not as good as other dragons with pure blood.

pudding?

What kind of name is this? It’s not cool at all, no no!

The flames around Feng Ci swelled, and Yinlong trembled. Pudding will be pudding!
